source.subset_parsed: January 2025, 31 days, 11x11 native-coordinate request; 3,751 qualifying cells.

response_status.basis: The connector returns bytes only for HTTP 200; it raises SOURCE_HTTP_ERROR for every other status. The tests passed through that connector path. Status was not separately emitted by pytest.

result.warnings: Two non-fatal pytest warnings because record_property is paired with configured junit_family=xunit2; all three response properties are present in the saved report.
result.prior_attempt: The screenshot records an earlier attempt with one passing case and one SOURCE_TIMEOUT failure after 90.92 seconds; the follow-up JUnit run passed both cases.

preserved_baseline.input_compatibility: verified for the captured bytes, calendar, same MUR product/version, native grid and QC inputs
preserved_baseline.registered_source_document: docs/sources/scientific_baselines.yaml remains byte-preserved under the P00 checksum; its UNKNOWN status is not silently rewritten by this engineering probe.

rights_and_attribution.attribution: Retain JPL MUR MEaSUREs / PO.DAAC citation and EUMETSAT OSI SAF attribution for the listed Ice_Conc-OSISAF source input; exact OSI SAF product identifier is not named in the NOAA metadata.
rights_and_attribution.assessment_limit: Records the dataset metadata and attribution obligations for reuse; not a legal opinion.

redacted_http_telemetry.http_status_note: 200 inferred from the successful connector return path; current JUnit does not emit the status field separately.
redacted_http_telemetry.transient_error: SOURCE_TIMEOUT on the earlier subset request; successful bounded retry run followed.

scientific_limitations: The 20-year January comparator is product-specific, not a 30-year WMO climate normal.
The 0.1-degree pilot tile is not a whole-Arabian-Sea estimate.
The baseline was retrieved after January 2025; no historical-as-of-2025 availability claim is made.
Input compatibility and deterministic parsing do not validate anomaly statistics, uncertainty assumptions, thresholds, or scientific conclusions.
